title: What are Gemini Gems? And how to use them
summary: Gemini Gems let you build your own custom chatbots using natural language. Here's a detailed guide on how to create, edit, duplicate, and delete Gemini Gems.
body_markdown: Build automations from wherever you work. Describe the outcome you want, and Zapier connects your tools, runs the steps, and stays on the job after you close the chat. Combine AI with reliable, deterministic automation across 9,000+ apps.[Get started for free.](https://zapier.com/sign-up)
